title: OpenAI Revises Model Spec, Naming Five Values to Guide Its AI Models
summary: OpenAI revises model spec, establishing five core values to guide AI behavior
detailed: Five principles now anchor OpenAI’s guidance for its AI models after a revision announced Thursday.
The framework lists faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care.
OpenAI described the change as an effort to improve its models’ understanding of what people intend and the values they hold.
Simon Yoon reports on blockchain technology for TokenPost.
